The CONTACT/SAFE pair is designed to admit a visible track before physical loss; it does not itself prove any tracker succeeds.
Model-only evidence contains dense RGB/depth, calibration, time, current camera/wearer pose, and immutable plan receipts, but no actor oracle.
Instance segmentation, witness RGB, actor states, physical occlusion, contact, semantic roles, and outcome labels remain evaluator-only.
All four formal sensors are captured at 1280x720 in fresh CARLA server processes; the older 320x180 C1 canary remains immutable.
